osfriedenssaal.name: Friedenssaal
osfriedenssaal.slogan: The room where thirty years of war finally ran out of road.
osfriedenssaal.line: Two treaties ending the Thirty Years' War were signed on 24 October 1648, in Osnabrück and Münster.

oskalkriese.name: Kalkriese Varus Battle Site
oskalkriese.slogan: Where Arminius's warriors swallowed three Roman legions.
oskalkriese.line: Over 5,500 Roman objects have been dug up here since 1988, including the earliest known Imperial Roman face-mask.

osmeyerwerft.name: Meyer Werft
osmeyerwerft.slogan: Cruise liners born inland, then towed down the Ems.
osmeyerwerft.line: The yard was founded in 1795 in Papenburg; finished ships travel about 36 km down the Ems to the Dollart bay.

osnussbaumhaus.name: Felix-Nussbaum-Haus
osnussbaumhaus.slogan: Sharp-angled walls for a painter who refused to be silenced.
osnussbaumhaus.line: Opened in 1998, the museum shows the life work of Felix Nussbaum, who was deported to Auschwitz on 2 August 1944.

osdom.name: Osnabrück Cathedral
osdom.slogan: Charlemagne's mission church, still ringing over the old town.
osdom.line: The first cathedral here dates to 785, and the Osnabrück Wheel fell from its tower in the 1944 bombing.
